quarterly_data.signal: The company pivoted toward proteoform assays, targeting early access for an AKT1 oncology assay in late 2026, general availability for both AKT1 and tau assays in mid-2027, a second oncology assay in mid-2027 and roughly 20 assays by mid-2028.
quarterly_data.figure: AKT1 early access late 2026; ~20 assays by mid-2028

quarterly_data.signal: Nautilus reported its first revenue of $0.2 million and expected approximately $0.5 million for the year. Cash and equivalents were $129.2 million, supporting a stated runway into the first quarter of 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: first revenue $0.2M; FY ~$0.5M; cash $129.2M; runway Q1 2028

quarterly_data.signal: Voyager preorders are planned for early 2027 and shipments for mid-2027. Management described a target instrument price of approximately $1 million and assay kits priced at several thousand dollars per sample.
quarterly_data.figure: preorders early 2027; shipments mid-2027; instrument target ~$1M

connects_to.relationship: proteoform research collaboration and biological data generation
